verdict.rationale: The docs describe the exact loop in the story. You send conversation turns to `add` (`client.add(messages, user_id=...)`), Mem0 extracts the individual facts, and you call semantic `search` with optional reranking before the next model request, with scoping by user and session so context persists across sessions. Community users independently describe it as conversation-fact storage with semantic search and report using it in a hackathon and in production. Missing for 10: independent hands-on measurement of retrieval or recall quality, since one hackathon user said the interface between structured and unstructured memory still needs work.
